selection.stage1_rule: Rank training candidates without Eval; retain exactly the top three and confirm those candidates on Tuning seeds 2027 and 2028 before choosing a training configuration.
selection.stage2_rule: Freeze the training configuration first, then rank final-memory heads. Do not perform a joint 320-way selection.
selection.dataset_specific_rule: Every dataset selects its own training and head parameters; track-level fallback is forbidden.
